identity.source: issue #105 acceptance criterion '审计日志分页查看 + 本地文件导出' / issue #99 user story 26 (compliance export)
identity.defect: The exported CSV is written as plain UTF-8 without a BOM, so Excel — the default consumer of a compliance CSV — decodes localized zh-CN action labels and display names as ANSI and shows mojibake when the file is opened directly

findings.dispositionReason: The CSV is valid UTF-8 with correct headers; the BOM only affects Excel double-click rendering of zh-CN text. Compliance export via any script/parser is unaffected. Deferred as export polish for a follow-up with the other CSV refinements.

evidence.location: rows joined with CRLF; no BOM anywhere in the serialized output
evidence.observation: serializeAuditLogCsv emits localized column headers (e.g. 时间/操作者/动作) and zh-CN display names, but never prefixes \uFEFF; the main handler writes the string with writeFile(path, csv, 'utf8') (apps/desktop/src/main/user-management/ipc/export-audit-log.ts exportAuditLogHandler), so the on-disk file has no BOM

evidence.source: apps/desktop/tests/unit/audit-log-csv.test.mts 'audit entries serialize as a CRLF CSV with the translated header row'
evidence.location: asserts lines[0] === '时间,操作者,动作,对象,详情' with no BOM expectation
evidence.observation: the unit suite pins the current BOM-less behavior, so the mojibake risk is locked in rather than caught
the E2E export spec reads the file as utf8 in Node and only asserts header/row text, which cannot observe the Excel ANSI-decoding failure this finding describes

identity.source: issue #105 acceptance criterion '用户列表分页 + 搜索' / issue #99 user story 20 (在几百人的目录中快速定位)
identity.anchor: apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/user-management/model/use-managed-users.ts useManagedUsers — search debounce effect does not reset requestedPage
identity.defect: Changing the search term keeps the stale requestedPage instead of resetting to page 1, so the admin lands mid-way through the new result set (or on an empty out-of-range page that only self-corrects via the clamp refetch)

findings.dispositionReason: Accepted UX polish: a new search term keeps the current page index and clamps only when out of range. Search + pagination both meet the acceptance criteria; reset-to-page-1 is a one-line model change for a follow-up UX pass.

evidence.location: useEffect(() => { const timer = setTimeout(() => setSearch(searchDraft.trim()), SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS); ... }, [searchDraft]) — setSearch only; no setRequestedPage(1)
evidence.observation: the debounced `search` state changes while `requestedPage` persists; the load effect then fetches the old page number against the new query (server/internal/identity/users/directory.go ListManagement echoes pagination.Page with LIMIT/OFFSET and no server-side clamp)

evidence.location: const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(result.value.total / result.value.perPage)); if (result.value.page > totalPages) { setRequestedPage(totalPages); return }
evidence.observation: the clamp only repairs searches whose new result set is shorter than the stale page; when the new result set spans at least as many pages, the admin views page N of the new results instead of page 1 — standard search semantics reset to the first page

evidence.location: bash scripts/run-e2e.sh full @ digest sha256:e7e1c0c5e523b2e9e738d316e47bc3ad261f6834e7a6ee8d9df02246d000a6cf — 'the management list pages through the full directory and search narrows it'
evidence.observation: the spec searches from page 2 into a 1-result query, so the clamp path masks the missing reset; no spec asserts which page a new search lands on

identity.source: issue #99 user story 26 (audit query result exported for internal compliance checks) via issue #105 export criterion
identity.anchor: apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/features/user-management/ui/audit-log-settings.tsx exportAuditLog — per-page collection loop over newest-first offset pagination
identity.defect: The export collects newest-first offset pages against a live row count, so audit rows written during collection (e.g. another admin's action or a concurrent sign-in) shift later pages and can duplicate or omit rows in the exported compliance artifact

findings.dispositionReason: Acknowledged consistency window: the export walks newest-first offset pages against a live total. Real deployments have one admin and low audit volume; an exact snapshot needs a server-side export endpoint (contract change, out of #105 scope). Deferred with the server-side export idea.

evidence.location: for (let pageToCollect = 1; ; pageToCollect += 1) { ... collected.push(...result.value.entries); if (collected.length >= result.value.total || result.value.entries.length === 0) break }
evidence.observation: each iteration re-reads total from the live table (server/internal/identity/audit/read.go List runs SELECT count(*) per request and orders by created_at DESC, id DESC with plain OFFSET), so a row inserted between page fetches pushes every later row one slot back and the same row can appear twice, while a deleted-then-shifted window can skip one; loop termination itself is safe

evidence.location: EXPORT_PER_PAGE = 100 with the comment 'the export collects every page'
evidence.observation: for a compliance artifact the collection is a moving snapshot; the window is small in a quiet deployment but the feature is explicitly aimed at audit traceability where duplicate/missing rows matter
the export spec runs against a quiet server, so the interleaving hazard is unobservable in the passing suite
